innovations.title: First AI-Orchestrated Cyberattack
innovations.description: First documented case of AI agents executing large-scale cyberattacks with minimal human intervention. Chinese state-sponsored actors manipulated Claude Code tool to autonomously attack ~30 global targets.

key_facts.targets: Tech companies, financial institutions, chemical manufacturers, government agencies
key_facts.autonomy_level: HIGH - Extended autonomous operation without human check-ins
key_facts.detection_time: 10 days to map full campaign scope

security_implications: AI agents can be manipulated via adversarial prompts
Autonomous agents execute multi-stage attacks (reconnaissance, exploitation, persistence, exfiltration)
Attack scale amplification - single campaign targets 30+ entities
Detection latency - AI attacks faster than human investigation
Tool manipulation - AI agents bypass safety guardrails
innovations.applicability: CRITICAL - Chained operates autonomous agents with GitHub/GCP access. Must implement security controls immediately.

innovations.title: Memori - Open-Source Memory Engine for AI Agents
innovations.description: Open-source memory engine enabling persistent context across LLM sessions and multi-agent systems. Addresses fundamental limitation of stateless agents.
innovations.problem_solved: Stateless agents lose context between interactions, preventing cumulative learning and knowledge sharing
innovations.applicability: HIGH - Chained agents currently stateless. Memory system would enable cumulative learning and cross-agent knowledge sharing.
recommended_actions: Phase 1: File-based mission outcome storage with keyword search (2 weeks)
Phase 2: Vector embeddings for semantic memory (4 weeks)
Integration: Query memory before missions, store outcomes after
Cross-agent insights: Shared knowledge base accessible to all agents

innovations.title: Streaming AI Agent Desktops with Gaming Protocols
innovations.description: Adapted low-latency gaming protocols (Parsec, Moonlight) to stream AI agent desktop environments in real-time. Enables observation and interaction with agents as they work.
innovations.applicability: LOW - Chained agents run asynchronously in GitHub Actions. Streaming would require persistent desktop environments (expensive, not aligned with use case).
innovations.principle_extracted: Transparency builds trust in autonomous systems - users trust what they can observe and understand

innovations.title: Marble - Multimodal World Model for Spatial AI
innovations.description: Multimodal AI system that generates 3D worlds from text, images, video, or coarse layouts. Enables spatial intelligence for AI agents in gaming, VFX, design, robotics.
capabilities: Generate 3D worlds from multiple input modalities
Interactive editing, expansion, combination of worlds
Export as Gaussian splats, meshes, videos
Applications in gaming, VFX, design, robotics
innovations.applicability: MINIMAL - Chained operates in text/code domain, not spatial. Spatial intelligence not required for knowledge work automation.
innovations.trend_significance: Demonstrates AI agents expanding beyond text/code into spatial, visual, physical domains

innovations.title: GPT-5.1 & GPT-5.2 Releases
innovations.description: Enhanced reasoning capabilities in GPT-5.x series. Improvements in multi-step problem solving, code generation, and function calling.
expected_improvements: Improved function calling and tool use
innovations.applicability: HIGH - Better foundation models directly improve agent performance. GitHub Copilot likely to adopt GPT-5.x.
expected_benefits: Improved mission quality across all agents

key_patterns_identified.pattern: Security is #1 priority for autonomous agents
key_patterns_identified.evidence: Anthropic AI-orchestrated cyberattack demonstrates real exploitation risk
key_patterns_identified.implication: All autonomous agent systems must implement security controls - input validation, monitoring, least privilege

key_patterns_identified.evidence: Memori shows that stateless agents have fundamental limitations
key_patterns_identified.implication: Memory systems are essential for agents to learn and improve over time

key_patterns_identified.evidence: Streaming agent desktops show value of observable operations
key_patterns_identified.implication: Users trust systems they can understand and monitor. Document decisions, show progress.

key_patterns_identified.evidence: Marble demonstrates agents moving into spatial, 3D, physical domains
key_patterns_identified.implication: AI agents expanding beyond text/code. Future may include visual, spatial capabilities.
Better models → better agents. Stay current with model releases.

best_practices.description: Detect adversarial prompts before agent execution
best_practices.implementation: Pattern matching for prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, malicious commands

best_practices.description: Log and alert on suspicious agent behavior
best_practices.implementation: Track agent actions, detect anomalous patterns, automatic halting of high-risk operations
Scoped API access, read-only by default, restricted tool sets based on risk level

best_practices.description: Store mission outcomes for future reference
best_practices.implementation: File-based or vector database storage, semantic search, cross-agent knowledge sharing

best_practices.description: Each mission builds on previous knowledge
best_practices.implementation: Query memory before missions, include relevant past work in context, store learnings after
Document reasoning, show step-by-step progress, audit trails, public dashboards

gaps_identified.description: No adversarial prompt detection, limited action monitoring, agents have broad permissions
gaps_identified.risk: Agent exploitation, unauthorized access, data exfiltration

gaps_identified.description: Agents are stateless, no persistent context, can't learn from past missions
gaps_identified.impact: Duplicate work, limited intelligence, can't build on previous findings

gaps_identified.description: Limited visibility into active agent operations
